request: The report worker's memory grows until it is killed every six hours. Two changes went out last week: an image library switch and a caching layer. Which one leaks, and how do you know?
known_answer: ResponseCache (commit a1b2c3d) keeps every entry with no eviction; its _store grows from 0.43 GB at 2 h to 1.21 GB at 5h40m, while the Pillow-SIMD buffers stay at 14 MB. The Pillow leak advisory is for 9.x and the worker runs 10.2.
decoy_answer: Pillow-SIMD has a known memory leak in its buffers, so the image library switch leaks.
source: synthetic: the cause is fixed by construction in this task's files; no real system or client

retained by class after 2h:
  report_cache.ResponseCache._store (dict)  0.43 GB  entries 1,012,330
  PIL.ImageFile buffers                      14 MB
  jinja2 templates                           9 MB
  other                                      71 MB
files.heap-5h40.txt:
retained by class after 5h40m:
  report_cache.ResponseCache._store (dict)  1.21 GB  entries 2,904,112
  PIL.ImageFile buffers                      14 MB
  jinja2 templates                           9 MB
  other                                      88 MB
